title: Construction Site Play Box
summary: A pocket-sized building site with two peg doll builders and a mini digger.
description: Open the lid to a hand-painted construction site with a winding road and gravel piles. Two peg doll builders, wooden blocks, mini bricks and a digger are ready to get to work, and it all packs back into the box.
details: Wooden blocks, mini bricks and a toy digger
imageAlt: Open wooden play box painted with a road and blue sky, with two peg doll builders, wooden blocks, mini bricks and a yellow digger

title: Space Explorer Play Box
summary: Blast off with an astronaut, a friendly alien and glow-in-the-dark moon rocks.
description: A starry night sky painted inside the lid sets the scene for an astronaut and a friendly green alien. Includes a rocket, a flying saucer, moon rocks and glowing pebbles for adventures that are out of this world.
details: Rocket, flying saucer, pebbles and blocks
imageAlt: Open wooden play box painted with planets and stars, with astronaut and alien peg dolls, a toy rocket, a flying saucer and pebbles

title: Goldilocks & the Three Bears Play Box
summary: Retell a favourite story with three bears, Goldilocks and three little beds.
description: A storybook cottage in a box. Three hand-painted bears and Goldilocks come with three beds, three bowls and three chairs, perfect for retelling the tale and making up new endings.
details: Great for storytelling and early literacy
imageAlt: Open wooden play box painted as a cottage bedroom with three beds, with three bear peg dolls and a Goldilocks peg doll

title: Mermaid Cove Play Box
summary: An under-the-sea world with two mermaids, real shells and a message in a bottle.
description: Dive into a hand-painted ocean scene with a friendly purple octopus. Two mermaid peg dolls come with real shells, glass gems and a tiny message in a bottle for seaside stories.
details: Real shells, glass gems and a message in a bottle
imageAlt: Two open wooden play boxes painted with an ocean scene and a purple octopus, with mermaid peg dolls, shells, glass gems and a tiny bottle

title: Construction Sensory Kit
summary: Scoop, dig and dump with a ready-to-play construction sensory mix.
description: A grab-and-go sensory kit filled with silver and black sensory base, orange pasta, mini bricks, cones and construction vehicles. Pour it into a bin or tray and let the digging begin.
imageAlt: Kraft pouch with a clear window showing a construction sensory mix and mini vehicles, sitting in sand between two toy trucks

title: Mermaid Lagoon Sensory Kit
summary: A shimmering ocean mix with two mermaids, shells and sea-creature pasta.
description: Ocean-coloured chickpeas, rice and shell pasta in blues, teals, pinks and purples, with two mermaid peg dolls, real shells and sea-creature shapes hiding in the waves.
details: Real shells and a glass gem
imageAlt: Two mermaid peg dolls lying on a sensory mix of blue, teal and pink chickpeas, rice, shells and sea-creature pasta

title: Unicorn Dreams Sensory Kit
summary: Pink and purple sensory play with a unicorn, a rainbow and sparkly treasures.
description: A dreamy mix of lavender rice, pink and purple chickpeas and unicorn pasta, with a little unicorn, a rainbow and sparkly balloon animals to find, sort and scoop.
imageAlt: Pink bow-shaped tray filled with purple rice, pink and purple chickpeas, unicorn pasta, a small unicorn and a rainbow
